decisions.markdown_control: Accept/Approve checkbox on a suggestion: checked approves the suggestion, unchecked skips it.
Keep Source checkbox on a suggestion: keeps the origin inbox note instead of deleting it.
Delete Source/Delete checkbox on a suggestion: explicitly deletes the origin.
Force Atomic checkbox on a suppressed light block: promotes it to a full atomic note.
Title/Suggested name/Suggested title/Name field line on a suggestion: retype to rename; the filename derives from it.
Template field line on a suggestion: retype the template wikilink target.
Destination/Location/Move to field line on a suggestion: retype the destination folder.
Tags/Tag/New tags to add/New tags field line on a suggestion: retype the tag list to add.
Approve/Skip checkbox on a Proposed MOC block: checked approves creating the MOC, unchecked skips it.
Name field line on a Proposed MOC block: retype to rename the MOC.
Parent field line on a Proposed MOC block: retype to reparent.
Tags/Tag/New tags/Suggested tags field line on a Proposed MOC block: retype the tag list to add.
Accept checkbox under a daily note's Possible Trackers block: checked accepts the tracker suggestion.
Leading time token on a Possible Log Entries line, or the separate '- Time:' sub-field: retype to change when the entry lands.
Leading position token (a time, or after_last_line/before_first_line) on a Possible Log Entries line: retype to change where the entry is inserted.
Text after the em dash on a Possible Log Entries line: retype to change the log-entry content.
Accept checkbox under a daily note's Possible Log Entries block: checked accepts the log-entry suggestion.
Force Atomic Note checkbox on a Possible Log Entries item: checked promotes it to a full atomic note.
Accept checkbox under a daily note's Possible Log Links block: checked accepts the log-link suggestion.
Approve checkbox on a Tag-Handler Updates group block: checked approves the group's changes.
Keep source files checkbox on a Tag-Handler Updates group block: keeps the source files instead of removing them.
Checkbox on a wikilinked MOC under a suggestion's 'Link to MOC:' or 'Parent MOC:' header: checking it links the MOC; checking an unlisted wikilink here adds a user-sourced candidate (source='user').
decisions.note: suggestions[].candidate_mocs[].source is the same control's side effect, not a separate decision.

decisions.markdown_control: Placement line following a checked MOC checkbox: overrides where the link is inserted.
Rename / Keep in inbox / Ignore checkboxes on an Attachment Conflicts entry: the three ticks resolve to one remedy.
decisions.note: The remedy has no wire field yet; expected to gain one once the wire is extended to carry it.
